class.name: HTMLLayout
class.brief_description: Parses and lays out HTML for drawing on a [CanvasItem].
class.description: Use [method parse] to load an HTML document or fragment and [method layout] to set its viewport size. Call [method draw] from the target [CanvasItem]'s [method CanvasItem._draw] callback. Call [method CanvasItem.queue_redraw] after changing the document, viewport size, or drawing position. Supports block and inline layout, lists, tables, text, backgrounds, and local images. Borders support [code]solid[/code], [code]dashed[/code], [code]dotted[/code], and [code]double[/code], with separate styles, widths, and colors per side. [code]border-radius[/code] rounds backgrounds, borders, and images, and clips overflowing children when [code]overflow: hidden[/code] is set. Backgrounds support [code]linear-gradient()[/code], [code]radial-gradient()[/code], and [code]conic-gradient()[/code] with sRGB color interpolation. Text uses the project theme's default font or Godot's fallback font. Run the renderer on the main thread. [code]box-shadow[/code] supports offsets, blur, spread, and comma-separated layers. Use [code]inset[/code] for an inner shadow. Shadows follow [code]border-radius[/code] and leave layout and scroll ranges unaffected.

method.name: clear
method.description: Releases the document, layout, and drawing resources, and clears the last error.

method.name: create_element
method.description: Creates an element owned by this layout after a successful [method parse]. Pass a tag name such as [code]li[/code] or [code]quest-card[/code]. ASCII letters in the name are lowercased. Returns [code]null[/code] if the name is invalid or there is no parsed document. The new element has no parent. Set its attributes and content, then insert it using [method HTMLElement.append_child] on a parent from the same layout. Unattached elements are outside document queries and have no layout rectangles. On an empty document, the first creation also makes [code]html[/code], [code]head[/code], and [code]body[/code] available to queries.

method.name: draw
method.description: Draws the current layout during [method CanvasItem._draw]. Both the top-left drawing position and the optional axis-aligned clip rectangle are in the canvas item's local coordinates. The default clip applies only the document's clipping rules. Before a successful layout, this method draws nothing.

method.name: get_anchor_rect
method.description: Returns the bounds of the first laid-out element with the given case-sensitive HTML [code]id[/code], in document coordinates. Pass the ID without [code]#[/code]. Returns an empty rectangle if the element has no layout or the ID is absent.

method.name: get_content_size
method.description: Returns the content size in pixels from the most recent successful layout of the current document. Returns [constant Vector2i.ZERO] before layout and for an empty document.

method.name: get_element_at
method.description: Returns the frontmost element at the given document pixel position, accounting for overflow clipping. Returns [code]null[/code] when there is no hit or no layout.

method.name: get_element_by_id
method.description: Returns the first element with the given case-sensitive HTML ID, including hidden elements. Pass the ID without [code]#[/code]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the ID is absent.

method.name: get_link_at
method.description: Returns the original [code]href[/code] of the link at a point in document coordinates, or an empty string. Subtract the drawing position from the canvas-local point and apply any caller-supplied clip before querying. The caller handles navigation.

method.name: get_render_error
method.description: Returns the diagnostic message from the last failed parse or layout. A successful parse or layout clears the message.

method.name: get_plain_text
method.description: Returns the laid-out text in document order. Block boundaries and explicit line breaks are represented by newlines, and table cells are separated by tabs. Soft wrapping does not add newlines. Returns an empty string before layout.

method.name: get_selection_rects
method.description: Returns highlight rectangles in document coordinates for the character range from [param from] up to [param to]. Offsets refer to [method get_plain_text] and are clamped to its length. Rectangles are clipped to the HTML layout's visible regions.

method.name: hit_test_text
method.description: Returns the nearest caret offset in [method get_plain_text] for a point in document coordinates. Returns [code]0[/code] when there is no text.

method.name: layout
method.description: Updates media queries and lays out the current document using the viewport width and height in pixels. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for nonpositive dimensions, [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] before a successful parse, or [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] if the layout cannot be represented.

method.name: parse
method.description: Replaces the document and resets its layout. An empty string creates an empty document. Styles come from inline attributes, [code]<style>[/code] elements, [code]<link rel="stylesheet">[/code], and the optional stylesheet text. Use [code]@import[/code] to include UTF-8 [code].css[/code] files within the project. Relative URLs in a CSS file are resolved from that file's directory. Relative URLs in HTML and stylesheet text are resolved from [param base_dir]. Paths may use [code]../[/code] within the project or absolute [code]res://[/code] paths. Images can be imported PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG textures. Missing or unsupported assets are skipped. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for a base directory outside [code]res://[/code], or [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] if the document cannot be parsed.

method.name: query_selector
method.description: Returns the first match in document order, or [code]null[/code]. See [method query_selector_all] for selector syntax.

method.name: query_selector_all
method.description: Returns matching elements from the litehtml element tree in document order, with each element included once. Tags, classes, IDs, attributes, combinators, and comma-separated lists are supported. Queries include hidden elements and are available after parsing. Invalid or unsupported selectors report an error and return an empty array.
